plugins.name: governance
plugins.description: Constitutional AI governance for Claude Cowork. Set modes, postures, and roles that persist across every action. Prompt-native enforcement — no shell dependencies. Built on MO§ES™ by Ello Cello LLC.

skills.name: audit
skills.description: Produces a structured summary of all governed actions, mode changes, and decisions made in this session. Use when reviewing what happened under governance, when you need a session log, or when you say 'show audit trail', 'what was governed', or 'session log'.
skills.description_zh: 汇总当前会话中受治理的动作、模式变化和决策，生成结构化审计轨迹及会话日志。

skills.name: docs
skills.description: Activates session-wide document governance: sequential numbering (001_, 002_...), structured headers, and cross-reference tracking on every document produced. Use when starting a governed work session, when you need traceable document output, or when you say 'track documents', 'number my docs', or 'document governance on'.
skills.description_zh: 启用 MO§ES 会话级文档治理，为产出文档设置顺序编号、结构化页首和交叉引用跟踪，以支持可追溯交付。

skills.name: govern
skills.description: Sets a constitutional governance mode that constrains Claude's behavior for the entire session — accuracy, security, creativity, or research depth. Use when starting a governed session, when you want behavioral guardrails applied to all responses, or when you say 'govern this session', 'set governance mode', or 'activate high-integrity mode'.
skills.description_zh: 为 MO§ES 会话设置准确性、安全、创意或研究深度等治理模式，用于约束整个会话的智能体行为。

skills.name: posture
skills.description: Sets the operational posture for the session — Scout (read-only), Defense (protect existing state), or Offense (execute and act). Use when you need to control what Claude is allowed to do, when preparing for a transaction or risky action, or when you say 'set posture', 'read-only mode', or 'go on offense'.
skills.description_zh: 设置 MO§ES 会话操作姿态：Scout 只读、Defense 保护现状或 Offense 执行动作，以规定可执行范围。

skills.name: role
skills.description: Sets the agent role in a MO§ES™ hierarchy — Primary, Specialist, or Observer — controlling authority level and behavioral scope. Use when coordinating multi-agent workflows, when you need to establish Claude's authority level, or when you say 'set role', 'act as specialist', or 'observer mode'.
skills.description_zh: 设置 MO§ES 层级中的 Primary、Specialist 或 Observer 角色，明确多智能体协作的权限等级和行为范围。

skills.name: stamp
skills.description: Embeds a MO§ES™ governance stamp into every document produced — active mode, posture, session ID, and integrity hash. The document itself becomes the audit record. Use when document provenance matters, when outputs need to be traceable, or when you say 'stamp outputs', 'governed documents', or 'embed audit in output'.
skills.description_zh: 在产出文档中嵌入 MO§ES 治理印记，包含活动模式、操作姿态、会话 ID 和完整性哈希，使文档自身保留审计记录。

skills.name: status
skills.description: Reports the complete current governance state — active mode, posture, role, vault contents, and event count. Use when you want a snapshot of all active governance settings, or when you say 'governance status', 'what mode am I in', or 'show governance state'.
skills.description_zh: 报告 MO§ES 当前治理状态，包括模式、操作姿态、角色、vault 内容和事件数量。

skills.name: vault
skills.description: Loads a governance document into active session context so it applies to all subsequent responses. Use when you want a policy, constitution, or reference document to govern all outputs, or when you say 'load this into vault', 'apply this document', or 'govern with this'.
skills.description_zh: 将政策、宪章或参考文档加载到 MO§ES 会话上下文，作为后续输出的治理依据。

commands.name: audit
commands.description: View the MO§ES™ governance audit trail for this session. Summarizes all mode changes, posture shifts, role assignments, and governed actions.

commands.name: coverify
commands.description: Verify commitment conservation between two texts. Extracts commitment kernels, scores similarity, detects ghost tokens. Tests whether meaning survived transformation — or names what leaked.

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Activate MO§ES™ document governance. Every document produced gets sequential numbering (001_, 002_...), a governance header, and cross-reference tracking.

commands.name: govern
commands.description: Set the active MO§ES™ governance mode. Applies behavioral constraints to all subsequent responses this session.

commands.name: hash
commands.description: Generate a session integrity hash — a fingerprint of the current governance state and conversation content. Use for audit continuity, handoff, or cross-session reference.

commands.name: lineage
commands.description: Declare and verify the MO§ES™ lineage anchor for this session. Confirms this governed session traces to the origin filing. Run at session start before high-stakes tasks.

commands.name: posture
commands.description: Set operational posture. Controls transaction scope and action boundaries for all Claude operations in this session.

commands.name: role
commands.description: Set agent role in the MO§ES™ hierarchy. Controls authority level and behavioral scope in multi-agent and collaborative workflows.

commands.name: stamp
commands.description: Embed a MO§ES™ governance stamp into every document produced this session. The output itself carries the audit record — mode, posture, session ID, action hash.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show full MO§ES™ governance state — active mode, posture, role, vault, and session event count.

commands.name: vault
commands.description: Load a governance document into active context. Rules in the document apply to all subsequent responses this session.
